description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of samples generated and the Micro F1 score for several models. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Samples Generated” and has a linear scale, ranging from K=8 to K=64, with tick labels at K=8, K=16, K=32, and K=64. The y-axis is labeled “Micro F1 (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 20 to 50, with tick labels at intervals of 5.  A blue line, representing TACRED, starts at approximately 24% at K=8 and increases to approximately 31% at K=64, with a slight dip to approximately 30% at K=32. An orange line, representing TACRED-Revisit, begins at approximately 27% at K=8 and remains relatively stable, fluctuating between approximately 29% and 31% across all values of K. A green line, representing Re-TACRED, starts at approximately 38% at K=8 and increases to approximately 43% at K=64, with a peak at approximately 44% at K=32. A red line, representing SemEval, begins at approximately 41% at K=8 and generally increases to approximately 48% at K=64, with a slight decline to approximately 46% at K=32.
